model_package_name: CardioVanta production package 1.1.1: portable (NumPy-only) export of cardiovanta-lr13@1.1.0, identical predictions

evidence: Trained by src/experiment/phase5.py on the raw target column of data/raw/heart.csv, which is inverted relative to UCI num (target 1 = num == 0; target 0 = num > 0): reports/phase17_multicenter_validation.md section 3; src/cardiovanta/data/external_loader.py parse_cleveland_dev_cohort.
Recorded in the clinical contract: cardiovanta_ml/contracts/feature_schema.v2.json model_label_mappings (cardiovanta-lr13 1.1.1, disease_present_label 0, interim_legacy).

calibration.cv: 5 StratifiedGroupKFold splits on duplicate-row groups of the 242 development rows; one sigmoid fitted on the pooled out-of-fold decision values (ensemble=False), applied to one pipeline refitted on all 242 rows
calibration.base_estimator: Pipeline(ColumnTransformer[StandardScaler(5 continuous), passthrough(3 binary), OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', 5 categorical)] -> LogisticRegression(C=0.1, class_weight='balanced', solver='lbfgs', random_state=42))
calibration.probability_semantics: predict_proba[:, index of label 0] = P(disease present) = 1 - P(label 1); exact for a binary sigmoid-calibrated classifier

explanation.description: Uncalibrated LogisticRegression parameters exported from the cardiovanta-lr13@1.1.0 explanation model; explains its own log-odds exactly.

runtime.note: Served with NumPy only. sklearn_version is the version the parameters were exported from.

provenance.registered: 2026-11-16. Portable export of cardiovanta-lr13@1.1.0; same fitted parameters, served without scikit-learn, SciPy or pandas.
